rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote:
Colon cancer GWAS data were sourced from the IEU GWAS catalog (UKB-B-20145).

Results:

: In this study, we identified one mediating relationship between inflammation, lipid, and colon cancer.
rows.coder_note: This paper's sentence gives the accession UKB-B-20145, an IEU OpenGWAS identifier of the ukb-b batch, which the MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline row registers (name and alias ukb-b); upper case is another written form (rule A) and nothing conflicts. The code rests on the accession, not on a cohort name.
